notes: Warehouse master data for inventory management, keyed by warehouseID. Full refresh only: /v1/warehouse exposes no lastModifiedDateTime filter parameter (WarehouseDto has a 'timestamp' field but it is not a query filter), so incremental sync is impossible — each sync fully replaces the table. Counts are small (<50 typical). Defines storage locations, default receipt/ship/return/drop-ship locations, cost valuation method, and branch association. DataMart query is config/queries/warehouse.graphql WITHOUT the nested `locations` selection: the field is typed WarehouseLocation! (non-null) but is null for warehouses without locations, and Visma then fails the WHOLE query with 'Cannot return null for non-nullable field' (measured 2026-09-29: every scalar field queries fine on its own; only `locations` breaks it). Normalizer parity vs the ERP on 15 shared keys (scripts/normalizer_parity.py): warehouseID, description, active, lockSitePICountEntry, locationEntry, avgDefaultCost, fifoDefaultCost equal; replenishmentClass matches on id; ZERO wrong values. branch and the four location fields stay null on purpose: DataMart holds INTERNAL ids (branchId 13, receiptLocationId 5435) where the ERP holds codes ('1'), 0 of 15 matched. contact, address, locations, timestamp do not exist on DataMart's root.
